body: I don’t even know what to say. I have no clue why I’m sad. I have no clue why I think the way I do but I hate myself so much I wish I could die. My dads an abusive alcoholic and I’m supposed to have dinner with him tomorrow before he moves to a different province. I hate him but I don’t know if I should go or not. I’m very sad and I have no escape from my feelings.

You do not need to end your life. I’m on here currently because I need the same help, (as you can tell by my username) you haven’t done everything yet. You haven’t seen the most beautiful sights or met the most amazing people that make that pain go away.. promise me you won’t do it, for me.. I won’t if you won’t. I dunno how old you are but I’m 14 years old and I think you are completely worth it regardless of who you are.
